subject: general
question:
If

'Q f R' means 'Q is the daughter of R',

'Q + R' means 'Q is the son of R',

'Q % R' means 'Q is the wife of R'.

'Q © R' means 'Q is the brother of R's wife and

'Q μ R' means 'Q is the father of R,

Then how is N related to K in the following expression?

M μ N f O f P + K
solution:
Let us first decode the given symbols and then draw a family tree.

Now draw a family tree using the following notations:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/538585574deea6d3f6f3d0ee75d66ddc3ab56d3ede620b37dd3a5549abfef4c5.png] 

M μ N f O f P + K

M is the father of N, N is the Daughter of O, O is the daughter of P, P is the son of K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa0eb78e9019e63eee9122279b1f21493824eb09960f6da8b8e6a8cccc23422a.png] 

N is the daughter of daughter of K's son.

Hence, the correct answer is **"son's daughter's daughter".**
